items.title: Old Yundum Residents Seek Hospital, Football Stadiums and End to Jabang Land Disputes
items.summary: By Assan Bah Residents of Old Yundum Constituency have appealed to the government to build a hospital, develop football stadiums and resolve long-standing land disputes in Jabang, as they called for further investment in roads, public safety and community facilities. The reque...
